column1: # and P1). A profile is the data `aontu render` applies to a unit of
# one language -- its lang, an indent, and optionally the comment
# forms, the string quote and escape table, the identifier rules and
# the type forms -- and it is DATA and only data: a field belongs here
# only if the renderer applies it without looking at the shape of any
# BUNDLED (ts/src/std.ts, go/std.go), served under the aontu: scheme,
# pinned by `shape-hash` in both engines. The root is not type()-marked
# (aontu-code.tsv says why); a profile document STATES a profile -- the
# vocabulary alone has no `lang` to generate.
# EXPERIMENTAL until the distribution layer can version it by
# Every expectation was obtained by running BOTH engines and diffing.

column3: @"aontu:profile"\nprofile: { lang: "typescript", lowering: "typescript", indent: { unit: " ", width: 2 }, comment: { line: { prefix: "// " }, doc: { open: "/**", prefix: " * ", close: " */" } }, str: { quote: "\\"", escape: { "10": "\\\\n", "9": "\\\\t", "92": "\\\\\\\\", "34": "\\\\\\"" } }, ident: { reserved: ["type", "class"], case: { record: "pascal", field: "camel" }, acronyms: [] }, types: { prim: { string: "string", int: "number" }, list: { close: "[]", prec: 2, childPrec: 2 }, opt: { close: " | null", prec: 1 } }, banner: "// Code generated by aontu. DO NOT EDIT." }
